name: Christophorus
beschreibung:
Quietly and sunnily situated in scenic Astlehn near Laengenfeld, Haus Christophorus provides a peaceful holiday retreat. The comfortably appointed rooms and apartments feature private balconies overlooking the Oetztal Alps.

The famous Aqua Dome thermal spa, cross-country tracks, and scenic trails are nearby, while top ski destinations like Soelden and Gurgl are just a short drive away.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Christophorus in Astlehn near Laengenfeld offers welcoming alpine lodging amidst the peaks of the Oetztal.
